TEC 2WI is a new series with the design purpose to improve the prevalent 2
Watt SIP-8 DC/DC converters in terms of cost, efficiency and performance. The
latest technology and components enable an increase in efficiency by more
than 20%. With the reduction of thermal loss, the operating temperature range
can be expanded from -40°C to +93°C. The converters are fully regulated over
0 - 100% load (no minimum load is required). The models are available with
ultra-wide input ranges of 4.5-18, 9-36 and 18-75 VDC. The functional
I/O-isolation system is designed to meet IEC/EN/UL 62368-1 (not certified)
with a test voltage (60 s) of 1600 VDC.
